definition_zh: 爆炸；一阵强风；轰鸣；猛烈批评
definition_en: an explosion, or a sudden strong movement of air
core_image: 爆破瞬间扬起的尘土
scene: 远处山脚腾起一团灰白的烟尘。The blast shook the windows of the town.
sceneCN: 这里 blast 是「爆炸」（第 1 个义项：突然的剧烈炸开）；句意是爆炸震动了镇上的窗户。

pos.zh: 名词：爆炸；一阵强风；轰鸣

derivatives.zh: 被炸毁的；该死的，用于加强语气
爆破，用炸药炸开岩石的作业

senses.title: A sudden explosion
senses.definition: a sudden violent burst of energy
senses.definitionCN: 突然而猛烈的能量爆开
senses.example: The blast shook the windows of the town.
senses.exampleCN: 爆炸震动了镇上的窗户。
senses.why: Gunpowder work gave the word this violent sense.
senses.whyCN: 炸药的作业让这个词有了这层猛烈的意思。

senses.title: A sudden rush of air
senses.definition: a sudden strong movement of air
senses.definitionCN: 突然而强劲的一股气流
senses.example: A blast of cold air hit us at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 一开门，一股冷风扑面而来。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, from the idea of blowing.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，来自「吹」这个概念。

senses.title: A very loud sudden noise
senses.definition: a sudden loud sound, as from a horn or trumpet
senses.definitionCN: 号角或喇叭发出的突然巨响
senses.example: The blast of the horn made her jump.
senses.exampleCN: 喇叭的巨响吓了她一跳。
senses.why: A horn blast is a burst of air made audible.
senses.whyCN: 号角声就是把一股气流变成了能听见的爆响。

senses.title: A strong attack in words
senses.definition: a very strong criticism
senses.definitionCN: 非常严厉的批评
senses.example: The film drew a blast from critics.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影招来评论家的猛烈批评。
senses.why: Verbal attack borrowed the force of an explosion.
senses.whyCN: 言语攻击借用了爆炸的力量感。

intro.en: Blast began as a word for blowing and later took on explosion.
intro.cn: blast 本指吹气，后来才获得爆炸的含义。

items.en: blæst meant a blowing of wind.
items.cn: blæst 意为一阵吹风。

items.en: blast named the sound of a trumpet.
items.cn: blast 指号角吹出的声音。

items.en: blasting with gunpowder gave the explosion sense.
items.cn: 用火药爆破让这个词有了爆炸义。

items.en: blast covered sudden loud noises of all kinds.
items.cn: blast 泛指各种突然的巨响。

items.en: blast also means a strong criticism.
items.cn: 如今 blast 也可指猛烈的批评。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bla- opening; the near-meaning group names explosions and gusts.
note.cn: 形近组都以 bla- 开头；近义组是爆炸与阵风类词。

normalIntro.en: Blast is a burst: of air, of sound, of fire, of words.
normalIntro.cn: blast 是一次爆发：气流的、声音的、火药的、言语的。

normal.en: A blast of wind is a sudden gust.
normal.cn: a blast of wind 是一阵突来的风。

normal.en: Blast off sends a rocket up.
normal.cn: blast off 指火箭发射升空。

normal.en: A bomb blast is an explosion.
normal.cn: a bomb blast 是炸弹爆炸。

normal.en: To blast someone is to criticize hard.
normal.cn: blast someone 是猛烈批评某人。

normal.en: Blast and blow share a root.
normal.cn: blast 与 blow 同根。

abstract.en: See dust rising from a hillside.
abstract.cn: 想象山坡上升起的尘土。

abstract.en: See a door blown open by wind.
abstract.cn: 想象门被风吹开。

abstract.en: See a trumpet at full volume.
abstract.cn: 想象一把吹到最响的小号。

examples.en: The blast shook the windows of the town.
examples.cn: 爆炸震动了镇上的窗户。

examples.en: A blast of cold air hit us at the door.
examples.cn: 一开门，一股冷风扑面而来。

examples.en: The film drew a blast from critics.
examples.cn: 这部电影招来评论家的猛烈批评。

dict_mnemonic.text: blast 与 blow 同源，一口猛吹是一阵狂风，吹得炸开就是爆炸。

root: blast 源自古英语 blæst，本义「一阵吹风」，与 blawan（吹）同根；中古英语指号角声，十七世纪火药爆破赋予爆炸义，后又引申为猛烈批评。

sensesIntro.en: Air, noise, fire and words can all come out in one blast.
sensesIntro.cn: 气流、声响、火药与言语，都可以是一次 blast。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: dust thrown up by an explosion at a hillside.
core.cn: 核心意象：山脚爆破扬起的尘土。

intro.cn: blast 加 -ed 与 -ing 构成形容词和名词。

items.meaning: the work of blowing up rock

definition_zh: 烈火；火焰；光辉； blazing 般的爆发；v. 燃烧；发光；开拓
definition_en: a strong bright fire, or to burn brightly and fiercely
core_image: 正午烈日下腾起的一团火光
scene: 干柴堆被点燃，火光冲天而起。The fire blazed through the dry forest all night.
sceneCN: 这里 blaze 是「熊熊燃烧」（第 2 个义项：猛烈而明亮地燃烧）；句意是大火在干燥的森林里烧了整夜。

derivatives.zh: blaze 加 -ing，义为「燃烧的；炽烈的」
blaze 加 -er，义为「运动夹克」（源自「鲜艳夺目」义）
a- 加 blaze，义为「着火的；闪耀的」

senses.title: A bright, strong fire
senses.definition: a large, brightly burning fire
senses.definitionCN: 大而明亮燃烧的火
senses.example: Firefighters fought the blaze for hours.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员与大火搏斗了几个小时。
senses.why: The Germanic root means to blow or shine; strong fire is the concrete core.
senses.whyCN: 日耳曼词根本指吹气或发亮，烈火是其具体核心。

senses.title: To burn brightly
senses.definition: to burn fiercely and with bright light
senses.definitionCN: 猛烈燃烧、放出强光
senses.example: The fire blazed through the dry forest all night.
senses.exampleCN: 大火在干燥的森林里烧了整夜。
senses.why: The noun made into a verb keeps the sense of fierce, visible burning.
senses.whyCN: 名词转动词，保留猛烈而可见的燃烧之义。

senses.title: A burst of bright light or colour
senses.definition: a brilliant display of light or colour
senses.definitionCN: 光或色的炫目爆发
senses.example: The garden was a blaze of colour in May.
senses.exampleCN: 五月的花园满园绚烂。
senses.why: Bright fire and bright colour are read by the same eye.
senses.whyCN: 明亮的火与明亮的色，在眼中是同一种「亮」。

senses.title: To shine intensely
senses.definition: to give out strong light, as eyes or the sun
senses.definitionCN: 发出强光，如眼睛或太阳
senses.example: Anger blazed in her eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 怒火在她眼中燃烧。
senses.why: Eyes that flash feel as hot as fire to the observer.
senses.whyCN: 闪光的眼睛在观者眼中如火焰般灼热。

senses.title: A sudden outburst of emotion
senses.definition: a sudden powerful showing of feeling or violence
senses.definitionCN: 情感或暴力的骤然强烈表露
senses.example: The speech set off a blaze of outrage.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇讲话激起了轩然大波的愤怒。
senses.why: Emotion burns like fire; the metaphor is the oldest fire we know.
senses.whyCN: 情感如火燃烧，这是人类最古老的火之隐喻。

senses.title: A mark cut on a tree to mark a path
senses.definition: a mark made on a tree to show a trail
senses.definitionCN: 刻在树上用于标示路径的痕迹
senses.example: Hikers followed the white blazes along the trail.
senses.exampleCN: 远足者沿着路上的白色路标前行。
senses.why: A blaze of the axe strips bark in a flash of pale wood.
senses.whyCN: 斧头一击剥落树皮，露出一片亮白的木色，故称 blaze。

senses.title: To pioneer a new path
senses.definition: to be the first to explore or develop something new
senses.definitionCN: 率先探索或开辟新领域
senses.example: She blazed a trail for women in engineering.
senses.exampleCN: 她为女性进入工程界开辟了道路。
senses.why: Pioneers cut trail marks; to blaze a trail is to chop the first path.
senses.whyCN: 先驱者砍刻路标，blaze a trail 即砍出第一道路径。

senses.title: To shoot continuously
senses.definition: to fire guns rapidly and continuously
senses.definitionCN: 用枪连续快速射击
senses.example: The soldiers blazed away at the targets.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵们朝目标连续射击。
senses.why: Muzzle flashes are little blazes, and firing repeats them.
senses.whyCN: 枪口火光如小火焰，连发便是火焰连绵。

intro.en: Blaze is a native Germanic word for bright fire.
intro.cn: blaze 是日耳曼本土词，本指明亮的火。

items.en: a reconstructed root blas-, connected with shining or blowing; exact form uncertain.
items.cn: 重构词根 blas-，与「发亮、吹气」相关，具体形式不确定。

items.en: blaese meant a torch or bright fire.
items.cn: 古英语 blaese 意为「火把；明亮的火」。

items.en: the tree-mark sense arose separately, probably from a blaze of pale wood.
items.cn: 中古英语时期生出「树皮刻痕」义，或因斧痕露出白亮木色。

items.en: blaze a trail was fixed in American frontier speech.
items.cn: 17 世纪 blaze a trail 在美国边陲用语中定型。

items.en: senses of fire, light, outburst, and pioneering all remain in use.
items.cn: 火、光、爆发、开拓诸义沿用至今。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers sound-alike words; the near-meaning group gathers words of fire and light.
note.cn: 形近组收音近词；近义组收火焰与光亮类词。

definition_zh: v. 漂白，使变白；n. 漂白剂
definition_en: to make something white or pale with chemicals or strong sunlight; a chemical used for this
core_image: 一件带黄渍的白衬衫泡在漂白水里，污渍一圈圈褪成白
scene: 她把白衬衫泡进漂白水里，第二天污渍全没了。She soaked the white shirt in bleach and by morning the stain was gone.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：bleach 作名词指漂白剂、作动词指漂白；句意是她把白衬衫泡进漂白水，次日污渍全消。

senses.title: To whiten cloth with chemicals
senses.definition: to remove colour or stains from cloth, paper or hair using a chemical agent
senses.definitionCN: 用化学药剂除去织物、纸张或头发上的颜色与污渍
senses.example: Cheap paper yellows quickly unless it is bleached.
senses.exampleCN: 廉价纸张若不漂白，很快就会发黄。
senses.why: Old English blǣcan meant to whiten, and the noun bleach is simply that action turned into a substance.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 blǣcan 意为使变白，名词 bleach 就是把这个动作变成一种物质。

senses.title: To be paled by sunlight
senses.definition: to lose colour through strong sunlight, so that a surface turns pale
senses.definitionCN: 因强烈日照而失色，表面变得苍白
senses.example: The curtains had been bleached to a thin grey.
senses.exampleCN: 窗帘被晒成了一种淡淡的灰。
senses.why: Sun does slowly what chemicals do fast, so the same verb covers both.
senses.whyCN: 阳光慢慢做的，正是化学品快速做的，于是同一动词兼指两者。

senses.title: The chemical itself
senses.definition: a liquid or powder that whitens and disinfects
senses.definitionCN: 能使物件变白并消毒的液体或粉剂
senses.example: Do not mix bleach with ammonia in the same bucket.
senses.exampleCN: 不要把漂白剂与氨水倒进同一个桶里。
senses.why: A verb naming an action often becomes a noun naming the stuff that performs it.
senses.whyCN: 表示动作的动词常转为表示施行该动作之物的名词。

intro.en: Bleach goes back to Old English blǣcan, to whiten, from blāc, pale, the same root that gives bleak.
intro.cn: bleach 上溯古英语 blǣcan（使变白），源自 blāc（苍白的），与 bleak 同根。

items.en: Blāc means pale or shining white.
items.cn: blāc 意为苍白、亮白。

items.en: Blǣcan is the verb to make pale or white.
items.cn: blǣcan 是「使变苍白、变白」的动词。

items.en: The verb appears in early English for whitening cloth.
items.cn: 该动词在早期英语中指漂白布料。

items.en: Lye and sour milk serve as the first bleaching agents.
items.cn: 碱液与酸牛奶是最早的漂白剂。

items.en: Open-air bleaching fields give their name to bleachers.
items.cn: 露天漂白场把自己的名字给了「露天看台」。

items.en: Bleach now means chlorine or oxygen bleach in a bottle.
items.cn: 现代 bleach 多指瓶装的含氯或含氧漂白剂。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the bl- start; the near-meaning group separates the colour change from the chemical that causes it.
note.cn: 形近组保留 bl- 开头；近义组把「变白的过程」与「造成它的药剂」分开。

normal.en: Blāc meant pale, and bleach is what makes pale.

normal.en: Sunlight bleaches curtains; chemicals bleach shirts.

abstract.en: A stain turning into nothing.

abstract.en: Whiteness bought with a chemical.

examples.en: Never bleach silk at home.

examples.en: The deck had been bleached by ten summers.

examples.en: Keep bleach away from the ammonia.

definition_zh: adj. 荒凉的，光秃秃的；阴冷的；无望的
definition_en: bare and exposed to wind; cold and raw; offering little hope for the future
core_image: 一面没有树的斜坡，枯草贴地，风从坡上直直刮下来
scene: 山坡上没有一棵树，风把枯草吹得沙沙作响。The hillside was bleak, with no trees at all and wind rattling the dry grass.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：bleak 指荒凉无遮蔽；句意是那片山坡没有一棵树，只有风吹枯草。

senses.title: Bare and exposed to weather
senses.definition: empty of trees or shelter and open to wind and cold
senses.definitionCN: 没有树木或遮蔽，暴露在风寒之中
senses.example: The cottage stood on a bleak moor with nothing behind it.
senses.exampleCN: 小屋立在一片荒原上，身后一无所有。
senses.why: The old word meant pale, and pale land is land with no green cover.
senses.whyCN: 这个古词本义是「苍白」，而苍白的土地就是没有绿意覆盖的土地。

senses.title: Cold and raw
senses.definition: of weather or wind, unpleasantly cold and damp
senses.definitionCN: 天气或风阴冷潮湿，令人不适
senses.example: A bleak wind came off the water all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 整个下午都有一股阴冷的风从水面吹来。
senses.why: Colour drains from a scene as cold drains warmth from it, so the same word names both.
senses.whyCN: 寒冷抽走暖意，就像苍白抽走颜色，于是同一个词兼指两者。

senses.title: Offering little hope
senses.definition: of a situation, seeming to offer no comfort or good outcome
senses.definitionCN: 局势显得毫无安慰与转机
senses.example: The report paints a bleak picture for small farms.
senses.exampleCN: 报告为小农场描绘了一幅黯淡的图景。
senses.why: A landscape with no shelter becomes a future with no shelter: the metaphor is spatial before it is emotional.
senses.whyCN: 没有遮蔽的风景变成没有遮蔽的未来：这个比喻先属于空间，后才属于情绪。

intro.en: Bleak came from Old Norse bleikr, pale, and shares its root with bleach.
intro.cn: bleak 来自古诺尔斯语 bleikr（苍白的），与 bleach 同根。

items.en: Bleikr means pale, the colour of land without green.
items.cn: bleikr 意为苍白，即没有绿意的土地之色。

items.en: The English cousin blāc carries the same pale sense.
items.cn: 英语同源词 blāc 同样表示苍白。

items.en: English bleak first describes pale or pallid things.
items.cn: 英语 bleak 最初形容苍白之物。

items.en: The word is applied to bare, windswept country.
items.cn: 该词被用于光秃、多风的地方。

items.en: Writers extend it to cold weather and grim situations.
items.cn: 作家把它扩展到寒冷天气与严峻处境。

items.en: Bleak now most often means without hope.
items.cn: 现代 bleak 最常表示没有希望。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the bl- start and the pale root; the near-meaning group runs from empty land to a hopeless forecast.
note.cn: 形近组保留 bl- 开头与「苍白」词根；近义组从空荡的土地排到无望的预期。

entries.definition: Dim and watery, as tired eyes.
entries.definitionCN: 模糊朦胧，如疲惫的眼睛。

normalIntro.en: A pale hillside with no trees, a cold wind, and a forecast with nothing good in it: all three are bleak.
normalIntro.cn: 没有树的光山坡、一阵冷风、一份没有好消息的预报：三者都叫 bleak。

normal.en: Bleak and bleach share the old word for pale.
normal.cn: bleak 与 bleach 共享表示「苍白」的古词。

normal.en: A pale landscape has no green left on it.
normal.cn: 苍白的风景上没有留下一丝绿。

normal.en: No trees means no shelter, and wind finds you.
normal.cn: 没有树就没有遮蔽，风就能找到你。

normal.en: Cold weather and grim news feel like the same landscape.
normal.cn: 阴冷的天气与黯淡的消息像同一片风景。

normal.en: If a report makes you shiver, it is bleak.
normal.cn: 如果一份报告让你发冷，它就是 bleak。

abstract.en: A hillside with nothing standing on it.
abstract.cn: 一寸立着的东西也没有的山坡。

abstract.en: Warmth and colour both withdrawn.
abstract.cn: 暖意与颜色同时被抽走。

abstract.en: A horizon that offers no next step.
abstract.cn: 不提供下一步的地平线。

examples.en: The mining town looks bleak in February.
examples.cn: 这座矿镇在二月显得一片荒凉。

examples.en: Analysts gave a bleak assessment of the currency.
examples.cn: 分析师对本国货币作出了黯淡的评估。

examples.en: They walked all day across bleak, treeless country.
examples.cn: 他们整天穿行在荒凉无树的地带。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不留客」——荒凉到这种地步，谁都留不住，风也得赶快走。

root: 古诺尔斯语 bleikr（苍白的）；与古英语 blāc、现代英语 bleach 同源

sensesIntro.en: The senses all describe withdrawal: green withdrawn, warmth withdrawn, hope withdrawn.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项都在描述「被抽走」：抽走绿色、抽走暖意、抽走希望。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a treeless slope under grey wind, grass pressed flat
core.cn: 核心意象：灰风下的无树山坡，草被压平

branches.en: A moor with one broken wall.
A field with no hedge left.
Wind coming straight off the sea.
A forecast with no good line in it.
A view that offers nothing to stand behind.
branches.cn: 不提供任何可依靠之物的景象。

intro.en: Bleak is an adjective with regular English endings; the list below builds its forms and the vocabulary of bare, cold scenes.
intro.cn: bleak 是带规则英语词尾的形容词；下面列出它的各种形式，以及荒凉阴冷词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin pallere is to be pale, vastare to lay waste, and frigere to be cold.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pallere 意为发白，vastare 意为使荒芜，frigere 意为寒冷。

latinEntries.exampleCN: pallere 产生 pale 与 pallid。
vastare 产生 devastate 与 vast。
frigere 产生 frigid 与 refrigerator。

definition_zh: 混合；融合；混合物
definition_en: to mix two or more things together smoothly
core_image: 搅拌机里旋成漩涡的果泥
scene: 搅拌机转起来，果块渐渐化成漩涡。Blend the fruit with a little milk.
sceneCN: 这里 blend 是「混合」（第 1 个义项：把几种东西搅在一起）；句意是把水果加一点牛奶搅匀。

derivatives.zh: 搅拌机，把食物打碎混合的电器
混合，把不同成分调和在一起的过程

senses.title: To mix smoothly together
senses.definition: to mix two or more things until they are combined
senses.definitionCN: 把两种或更多东西搅到合为一体
senses.example: Blend the fruit with a little milk.
senses.exampleCN: 把水果加一点牛奶搅匀。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, from an old verb meaning to mix.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，来自一个意为混合的古动词。

senses.title: To fit in with surroundings
senses.definition: to look or sound natural together
senses.definitionCN: 放在一起看起来或听起来自然
senses.example: The new houses blend with the old street.
senses.exampleCN: 新房子与老街很协调。
senses.why: Things that mix well also look as if they belong together.
senses.whyCN: 混得好的东西，看起来也像是本来就在一起。

senses.title: A mixture of things
senses.definition: a combination of different things
senses.definitionCN: 不同东西组合成的整体
senses.example: This tea is a blend of three leaves.
senses.exampleCN: 这款茶由三种茶叶拼配而成。
senses.why: The verb became a noun for the result of mixing.
senses.whyCN: 动词转为名词，指混合的结果。

intro.en: Blend came from an Old English verb for mixing, reinforced by Norse.
intro.cn: blend 来自古英语表示混合的动词，并受到诺斯语影响。

items.en: blandan meant to mix.
items.cn: blandan 意为混合。

items.en: blanda reinforced the word in northern England.
items.cn: blanda 在英格兰北部强化了这个词。

items.en: blenden became the modern blend.
items.cn: blenden 演变为今天的 blend。

items.en: blend named a mixture of teas or wines.
items.cn: blend 指茶或酒的拼配。

items.en: blend covers mixing, fitting in and the mixture itself.
items.cn: 如今 blend 兼指混合、协调与混合物。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bl- and -nd ending; the near-meaning group names mixing words.
note.cn: 形近组共用 bl- 开头与 -nd 结尾；近义组是表示混合的词。

entries.definition: to join two things into one

normalIntro.en: Blend is mixing until the edges between things disappear.
normalIntro.cn: blend 是搅到彼此之间的界限消失为止。

normal.en: Blend in means fit with the people around.
normal.cn: blend in 表示融入周围。

normal.en: A tea blend combines several leaves.
normal.cn: a tea blend 把几种茶叶拼在一起。

normal.en: A blender is the machine that does it.
normal.cn: blender 是做这件事的机器。

normal.en: Blend is both verb and noun.
normal.cn: blend 既可作动词也可作名词。

normal.en: Blind differs by one letter.
normal.cn: blind 与它只差一个字母。

abstract.en: See fruit spinning into a smooth swirl.
abstract.cn: 想象水果搅成顺滑的漩涡。

abstract.en: See new bricks matching an old wall.
abstract.cn: 想象新砖与旧墙颜色相合。

abstract.en: See two colours meeting without a line.
abstract.cn: 想象两种颜色相接却没有分界线。

examples.en: Blend the fruit with a little milk.
examples.cn: 把水果加一点牛奶搅匀。

examples.en: The new houses blend with the old street.
examples.cn: 新房子与老街很协调。

examples.en: This tea is a blend of three leaves.
examples.cn: 这款茶由三种茶叶拼配而成。

dict_mnemonic.text: blend 与 blind 只差一个字母，闭着眼也能把颜色混匀，混合就是 blend。

root: blend 源自古英语 blandan（混合），并受古诺斯语 blanda 影响，中古英语写作 blenden；由「搅在一起」引申为彼此协调，又转指混合物本身。

sensesIntro.en: Stir things together, let them fit, and the result is also a blend.
sensesIntro.cn: 把东西搅在一起，让它们彼此相合，这个结果也叫 blend。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fruit turning into a smooth swirl in a blender.
core.cn: 核心意象：水果在搅拌机里化成顺滑的漩涡。

intro.en: Blend adds -er for the machine and -ing for the process.
intro.cn: blend 加 -er 指机器，加 -ing 指过程。

latinIntro.en: The base is Germanic; Latin items below are related in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基属日耳曼语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

definition_zh: 祝福；保佑；使有幸拥有
definition_en: to ask God to protect and help someone
core_image: 教堂里伸出的祝福之手
scene: 教堂门口，老人把手轻轻放在孩子头顶。The priest blessed the couple at the door.
sceneCN: 这里 bless 是「祝福」（第 1 个义项：祈求神明护佑）；句意是牧师在门口为这对夫妇祝福。

pos.zh: 动词：使有幸拥有，赐予好事

derivatives.zh: 祝福；幸事，令人感激的好事

senses.title: To ask for divine protection
senses.definition: to ask God to protect and help a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 祈求神明保护并帮助某人或某物
senses.example: The priest blessed the couple at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 牧师在门口为这对夫妇祝福。
senses.why: This is the central religious sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词核心的宗教义项。

senses.title: To give someone a good thing
senses.definition: to give a person a valuable quality or advantage
senses.definitionCN: 赋予某人宝贵的品质或优势
senses.example: She is blessed with a fine voice.
senses.exampleCN: 她有幸拥有一副好嗓子。
senses.why: A gift from God became any fortunate gift.
senses.whyCN: 来自神明的赐予，扩展为任何幸运的馈赠。

senses.title: To give thanks over food
senses.definition: to ask God's blessing on a meal before eating
senses.definitionCN: 进食前祈求神明赐福这顿饭
senses.example: He blessed the food before dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚饭前他为食物做了祷告。
senses.why: The same prayer moved from people to the table.
senses.whyCN: 同样的祷告从人身上移到了餐桌上。

intro.en: Bless began as a marking rite and became a word of prayer.
intro.cn: bless 本指一种以血作记的仪式，后来成为祷告用语。

items.en: bletsian meant to mark with blood in sacrifice.
items.cn: bletsian 指献祭时用血作记号。

items.en: the word took on the Christian sense of blessing.
items.cn: 这个词获得了基督教祝福的含义。

items.en: benedicere, to speak well of, reshaped the meaning.
items.cn: 拉丁语 benedicere（说好话）重塑了它的意思。

items.en: bless became the everyday verb for a blessing.
items.cn: bless 成为表示祝福的日常动词。

items.en: bless covers prayer, thanks and good fortune.
items.cn: 如今 bless 兼指祈祷、感恩与好运。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bl- and -ess shapes; the near-meaning group names prayer and good fortune.
note.cn: 形近组共用 bl- 与 -ess 的形状；近义组是祈祷与好运类词。

normalIntro.en: To bless is to speak good over someone, whether in prayer or in thanks.
normalIntro.cn: bless 是对某人说好话，无论是在祈祷还是在感恩。

normal.en: Bless you follows a sneeze.
normal.cn: bless you 常在别人打喷嚏后说。

normal.en: Be blessed with means be lucky to have.
normal.cn: be blessed with 表示有幸拥有。

normal.en: The noun is blessing.
normal.cn: 名词形式是 blessing。

normal.en: The past tense adds -ed.
normal.cn: 过去式加 -ed。

normal.en: Bless and bliss differ by one letter.
normal.cn: bless 与 bliss 只差一个字母。

abstract.en: See a hand resting on a child's head.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手轻放在孩子头顶。

abstract.en: See a family bowing before a meal.
abstract.cn: 想象一家人饭前低头。

abstract.en: See a singer with an effortless high note.
abstract.cn: 想象歌手轻松唱出高音。

examples.en: The priest blessed the couple at the door.
examples.cn: 牧师在门口为这对夫妇祝福。

examples.en: She is blessed with a fine voice.
examples.cn: 她有幸拥有一副好嗓子。

examples.en: He blessed the food before dinner.
examples.cn: 晚饭前他为食物做了祷告。

dict_mnemonic.text: bless 与 bliss（极乐）只差一个字母，被祝福的人，心里满是喜乐。

root: bless 源自古英语 bletsian，原指献祭时以血作记的仪式，后受基督教用语影响转为「祝福」，又受拉丁语 benedicere（说好话）影响，引申为感恩与赐予好运。

sensesIntro.en: A prayer over people, a gift of good fortune, and thanks over food.
sensesIntro.cn: 为人祈祷、赐予好运、为食物感恩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand raised in blessing at a church door.
core.cn: 核心意象：教堂门口举起祝福的手。

intro.en: Bless forms a noun with -ing and an adjective with -ed.
intro.cn: bless 加 -ing 构成名词，加 -ed 构成形容词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Old English; the Latin benedicere shaped its later sense.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自古英语，拉丁语 benedicere 影响了它后来的含义。

definition_zh: 失明的；盲目的；百叶窗
definition_en: unable to see
core_image: 用白色手杖探路的人
scene: 他握着白色手杖，沿着墙边慢慢走。The blind man knew the street by sound.
sceneCN: 这里 blind 是「失明的」（第 1 个义项：看不见东西的）；句意是那位失明的男子靠声音认路。

senses.title: Unable to see
senses.definition: not able to see with the eyes
senses.definitionCN: 眼睛看不见东西的
senses.example: The blind man knew the street by sound.
senses.exampleCN: 那位失明的男子靠声音认路。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense and names the physical condition.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，直接指身体上的状况。

senses.title: Without careful judgment
senses.definition: done without thinking or checking
senses.definitionCN: 不加思考或不加核实地做
senses.example: She followed him with blind trust.
senses.exampleCN: 她怀着盲目的信任跟着他。
senses.why: Not seeing with the eyes became a picture for not seeing with the mind.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛看不见，被用来比喻心里也看不见。

senses.title: A window cover with slats
senses.definition: a cover of slats that can be pulled over a window
senses.definitionCN: 由条板组成、可以拉下来遮窗的帘子
senses.example: He pulled down the blinds before the film.
senses.exampleCN: 电影开始前他拉下了百叶窗。
senses.why: A cover that blocks sight took the name of being unable to see.
senses.whyCN: 挡住视线的遮帘，借用了「看不见」这个名字。

intro.en: Blind is an old Germanic word that spread from sight to judgment.
intro.cn: blind 是一个古老的日耳曼语词，从视力扩展到判断力。

items.en: blind meant without sight.
items.cn: blind 意为没有视力的。

items.en: blind gained the sense of lacking judgment.
items.cn: blind 获得了缺乏判断力的含义。

items.en: blinds named window screens.
items.cn: blinds 开始指窗户的遮帘。

items.en: blind spot entered everyday use.
items.cn: blind spot 成为日常说法。

items.en: blind covers sight, judgment and window covers.
items.cn: 如今 blind 兼指视力、判断与遮窗物。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bli- and -nd shapes; the near-meaning group names sight and shading.
note.cn: 形近组共用 bli- 与 -nd 的形状；近义组是视力与遮光类词。

normalIntro.en: Blind begins with the eyes and ends with the mind.
normalIntro.cn: blind 从眼睛开始，最后落在心里。

normal.en: Go blind means lose the ability to see.
normal.cn: go blind 表示失明。

normal.en: A blind spot is something you fail to notice.
normal.cn: blind spot 指自己没有察觉的地方。

normal.en: Blind faith is belief without checking.
normal.cn: blind faith 是不加核实的相信。

normal.en: Blinds cover a window.
normal.cn: blinds 是遮窗的百叶帘。

normal.en: The adverb is blindly.
normal.cn: 副词是 blindly。

abstract.en: See a white cane tapping the pavement.
abstract.cn: 想象白色手杖轻敲人行道。

abstract.en: See someone nod without looking.
abstract.cn: 想象有人没看清就点头。

abstract.en: See slats closing over a bright window.
abstract.cn: 想象条板一点点遮住明亮的窗。

examples.en: The blind man knew the street by sound.
examples.cn: 那位失明的男子靠声音认路。

examples.en: She followed him with blind trust.
examples.cn: 她怀着盲目的信任跟着他。

examples.en: He pulled down the blinds before the film.
examples.cn: 电影开始前他拉下了百叶窗。

root: blind 源自古英语 blind，属日耳曼语同源词，本义「看不见」；中古英语起引申为缺乏判断、盲目，十六世纪又指遮住光线的百叶帘。

sensesIntro.en: Eyes that cannot see, a mind that does not check, and a screen that blocks light.
sensesIntro.cn: 看不见的眼睛、不加核实的头脑、挡住光线的帘子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white cane feeling along a wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：白色手杖沿墙探路。

intro.en: Blind adds -ly and -ness to make an adverb and a noun.
intro.cn: blind 加 -ly 与 -ness 构成副词和名词。

definition_zh: n. 极乐，狂喜；至福
definition_en: perfect happiness; a state of complete content with nothing left to want
core_image: 怀里抱着熟睡的孩子，屋里只听见炉火的轻响
scene: 孩子在她怀里睡熟了，那一刻她只觉得无比幸福。Holding the sleeping child, she felt pure bliss.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：bliss 指毫无缺憾的极致幸福；句意是抱着熟睡的孩子，她感到纯粹的幸福。

forms.label: 不可数名词（无屈折变化）

senses.title: Perfect happiness
senses.definition: complete and untroubled happiness, with nothing wanted and nothing feared
senses.definitionCN: 完全无忧的幸福，无所求也无所惧
senses.example: A hot bath after a cold walk is bliss.
senses.exampleCN: 冷天走一遭之后泡个热水澡，就是极乐。
senses.why: Old English bliss comes from blīthe, gentle and glad, the same root as blithe.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 bliss 来自 blīthe（温和、喜悦），与 blithe 同根。

senses.title: The joy of heaven
senses.definition: in religious writing, the eternal joy of heaven
senses.definitionCN: 宗教文字中天堂的永恒之乐
senses.example: The hymn speaks of souls entering bliss.
senses.exampleCN: 这首赞美诗说到灵魂进入至福。
senses.why: Religious language took the strongest word for happiness and made it permanent.
senses.whyCN: 宗教语言取用最强的「幸福」一词，并让它成为永恒。

intro.en: Bliss descends from Old English blīthe, gentle and glad, the same word that became blithe.
intro.cn: bliss 源自中古英语之前的 blīthe（温和、喜悦），与 blithe 同出一词。

items.en: Blīthe means gentle, kind and glad.
items.cn: blīthe 意为温和、亲切、喜悦。

items.en: Blīths turns that gladness into a noun.
items.cn: blīths 把这份喜悦变成名词。

items.en: English bliss names perfect gladness.
items.cn: 英语 bliss 指完满的喜悦。

items.en: Preachers use bliss for the joy of heaven.
items.cn: 布道者用 bliss 指天国之乐。

items.en: Wedded bliss and domestic bliss become fixed phrases.
items.cn: wedded bliss 与 domestic bliss 成为固定说法。

items.en: Everyday speech uses bliss for small intense pleasures.
items.cn: 日常口语用 bliss 指小而强烈的愉悦。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the bl- plus s shape; the near-meaning group ranks happiness from delight to religious ecstasy.
note.cn: 形近组保留 bl- 加 s 的形状；近义组把幸福从欣喜排到宗教式的狂喜。

normalIntro.en: Bliss is the noun hiding inside blithe: the gladness itself, without the adjective.
normalIntro.cn: bliss 是藏在 blithe 里的名词：那份喜悦本身，去掉了形容词。

normal.en: Blithe is the adjective, bliss the noun.
normal.cn: blithe 是形容词，bliss 是名词。

normal.en: Both come from one old word for gentle gladness.
normal.cn: 两者都来自一个表示温和喜悦的古词。

normal.en: Bliss is happiness with nothing left to want.
normal.cn: bliss 是再无所求的幸福。

normal.en: Preachers made it mean heaven.
normal.cn: 布道者让它指天堂。

normal.en: A hot bath, a sleeping child: small bliss.
normal.cn: 一个热水澡、一个睡着的孩子：小小的极乐。

abstract.en: Happiness with no edge of worry.
abstract.cn: 不带一丝忧虑的幸福。

abstract.en: A moment that asks for nothing next.
abstract.cn: 不要求「然后」的一刻。

abstract.en: Gladness at full, with the tap closed.
abstract.cn: 喜悦满到顶，水龙头已关。

examples.en: The first coffee of the morning is pure bliss.
examples.cn: 早上第一杯咖啡就是纯粹的幸福。

examples.en: They spent a blissful week doing nothing at all.
examples.cn: 他们无所事事地度过了极其幸福的一周。

examples.en: The old hymn describes the bliss of the saved.
examples.cn: 这首古老的赞美诗描述了得救者的至福。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不理事」——幸福到极点时，什么事都不必理，躺着就好。

root: 古英语 blīthe（温和、喜悦）→ blīths（喜悦，名词）；与 blithe 同源

sensesIntro.en: Everyday bliss is a small perfect moment; religious bliss is that same moment made eternal.
sensesIntro.cn: 日常的 bliss 是小小的完满瞬间；宗教的 bliss 是把这瞬间变成永恒。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sleeping child in warm arms with the fire ticking
core.cn: 核心意象：壁炉轻响，孩子熟睡在温暖的怀里

branches.en: A first sip of hot coffee.
A quiet house after the guests leave.
A hymn about souls at rest.
branches.cn: 关于安息灵魂的赞美诗。

branches.en: Gladness with nothing to interrupt it.
branches.cn: 没有任何事来打断的喜悦。

intro.en: Bliss is a noun that mostly grows adjectives; the list below builds its family and the vocabulary of intense joy.
intro.cn: bliss 是个主要派生形容词的名词；下面列出它的词族与「强烈喜悦」词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin gaudium is joy, laetitia is gladness, and beare is to bless.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 gaudium 意为喜悦，laetitia 意为欢欣，beare 意为祝福。

latinEntries.exampleCN: gaudium 产生 joy 与 enjoy。
laetitia 产生 delight 与 elation。
beare 产生 beatify 与 beatitude。

definition_zh: adj. 无忧无虑的，快活的；漫不经心的，满不在乎的
definition_en: cheerful and carefree; showing a careless lack of concern that others may find irresponsible
core_image: 一个人哼着歌跳过水洼，全然不顾鞋已经湿了
scene: 他连道别都没有，带着无忧无虑的笑就上了船。With a blithe smile and no goodbye, he stepped onto the boat.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：blithe 指快活而不担忧；句意是他带着无忧的笑容上船，连道别都没有。

pos.zh: 无忧无虑的；漫不经心的

senses.title: Cheerful and free from care
senses.definition: happy, light-hearted and untroubled by worry
senses.definitionCN: 快乐轻松，不为忧虑所扰
senses.example: She has a blithe way of taking each day as it comes.
senses.exampleCN: 她有一种无忧的活法，过一天算一天。
senses.why: Old English blīthe meant gentle and glad, and it also gave us the noun bliss.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 blīthe 意为温和喜悦，也是名词 bliss 的来源。

senses.title: Carelessly unconcerned
senses.definition: showing no concern for consequences, often in a way that seems irresponsible
senses.definitionCN: 对后果毫不关心，常显得不负责任
senses.example: He waved away the warnings with blithe indifference.
senses.exampleCN: 他对警告满不在乎地挥了挥手。
senses.why: When cheerfulness stops noticing other people, it turns into carelessness.
senses.whyCN: 当快活不再顾及他人，它就变成了漫不经心。

intro.en: Blithe is Old English blīthe, gentle and glad; the noun bliss was built from the same word.
intro.cn: blithe 是古英语 blīthe（温和、喜悦）；名词 bliss 也由同一个词构成。

items.en: Blīthe means gentle, kind and cheerful.
items.cn: blīthe 意为温和、亲切、快活。

items.en: The noun blīths names gladness itself.
items.cn: 名词 blīths 指喜悦本身。

items.en: English blithe describes a light and kindly heart.
items.cn: 英语 blithe 形容轻快而善意的心。

items.en: The word begins to suggest a lack of proper concern.
items.cn: 这个词开始含有「不够上心」的意味。

items.en: Blithe disregard becomes a common critical phrase.
items.cn: blithe disregard 成为常见的批评用语。

items.en: Blithe now often carries a hint of reproach.
items.cn: 现代 blithe 常带一点责备意味。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -ithe rhyme or the old root; the near-meaning group moves from genuine cheer to culpable unconcern.
note.cn: 形近组共享 -ithe 韵脚或古老词根；近义组由真心的快活移到该受责备的漠然。

entries.definitionCN: 柔软灵活的，纤细优雅的。

entries.definition: Calm and casual about things that matter.
entries.definitionCN: 对要紧事也从容不在意。

normalIntro.en: Blithe is the old word for gentle gladness; push it too far and it becomes not caring at all.
normalIntro.cn: blithe 是古语里「温和的喜悦」；推得太远，就成了什么都不在乎。

normal.en: Blithe, bliss and bless all begin with bl- and feel light.
normal.cn: blithe、bliss、bless 都以 bl- 开头，都显得轻快。

normal.en: A blithe person steps over puddles without looking down.
normal.cn: blithe 的人跨水洼时不低头看。

normal.en: The same ease can look like charm or like carelessness.
normal.cn: 同一种轻快，可以是魅力，也可以是疏忽。

normal.en: Blithely ignoring a warning is still ignoring it.
normal.cn: blithely 地无视警告，仍然是无视。

normal.en: If no one else has to pay for it, blithe is a compliment.
normal.cn: 如果没人替你付出代价，blithe 就是称赞。

abstract.en: A step that never checks the ground.
abstract.cn: 从不查看脚下的一步。

abstract.en: Lightness mistaken for freedom.
abstract.cn: 被误认为自由的轻。

abstract.en: Cheer with the brake disconnected.
abstract.cn: 断了刹车的欢快。

examples.en: She was blithe about the risks of the trip.
examples.cn: 她对这趟旅行的风险满不在乎。

examples.en: He made a blithe promise he could not keep.
examples.cn: 他随口许下一个守不住的承诺。

examples.en: The children ran out, blithe and noisy, into the rain.
examples.cn: 孩子们快活地吵嚷着跑进雨里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不来事」——什么事都不来找他，他也懒得管任何事，只管快活。

root: 古英语 blīthe（温和、喜悦、亲切）；名词 bliss 同源

sensesIntro.en: The first sense is a temperament; the second is that temperament failing to notice other people.
sensesIntro.cn: 第一义是一种性情；第二义是这种性情没看见别人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone humming over a puddle, shoes already wet, not minding
core.cn: 核心意象：有人哼着歌跨过水洼，鞋早湿了，也不在意

branches.en: A song on the stairs in the morning.
Rain met without an umbrella and without complaint.
branches.cn: 没带伞淋了雨也不抱怨。

branches.en: Ease that may or may not cost someone.
branches.cn: 或需或无需他人付代价的轻松。

intro.en: Blithe is an old adjective with modern endings; the list below builds its forms and the vocabulary of light-hearted unconcern.
intro.cn: blithe 是配现代词尾的古老形容词；下面列出它的各种形式，以及「轻快不在意」词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin laetus is glad, securus is free from care, and neglegere is to neglect.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 laetus 意为欢欣，securus 意为无忧，neglegere 意为忽略。

items.exampleCN: 漫不经心的；善于观察的

latinEntries.exampleCN: laetus 产生 letitia 与 elation。
securus 产生 secure 与 sure。
neglegere 产生 neglect 与 negligent。

definition_zh: n. 暴风雪；大量涌来之物
definition_en: a severe snowstorm with strong wind and poor visibility; a sudden overwhelming quantity of something
core_image: 雪把公路埋到车窗高度，风把雪片横着抽过来
scene: 风雪下了两天，公路被埋到车窗那么高。The blizzard buried the highway to the height of the car windows.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：blizzard 指伴强风的暴雪；句意是暴风雪把公路埋到车窗高度。

senses.title: A snowstorm with violent wind
senses.definition: a heavy snowstorm driven by strong wind, with very poor visibility
senses.definitionCN: 强风卷雪、能见度极低的暴风雪
senses.example: The pass closes whenever a blizzard sweeps down from the ridge.
senses.exampleCN: 只要暴风雪从山脊扫下来，山口就会封闭。
senses.why: The word is American, first recorded in the early nineteenth century, and its origin is still uncertain.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是美国英语，十九世纪初首次记录，来源至今不确定。

senses.title: An overwhelming rush of things
senses.definition: a very large number of things arriving at once
senses.definitionCN: 一下子涌来的极大量事物
senses.example: The office was hit by a blizzard of complaints.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室被铺天盖地的投诉淹没。
senses.why: Snow driven sideways looks like a mass sent against you, so the metaphor moves from weather to paper.
senses.whyCN: 横着抽来的雪像一大堆东西朝你扑来，比喻便由天气转向纸面。

intro.en: Blizzard is an American word of the early 1800s, and no origin has been proved; an older sense meant a violent blow.
intro.cn: blizzard 是十九世纪初的美国词，来源未获证实；较早义为猛烈的一击。

items.en: The word appears in American writing in the 1820s.
items.cn: 这个词在十九世纪二十年代见于美国文字。

items.en: An earlier dialect sense is a violent blow or volley.
items.cn: 较早的方言义为猛烈的一击或齐射。

items.en: It settles on the meaning of a wind-driven snowstorm.
items.cn: 它固定为强风卷雪的暴风雪之义。

items.en: The great storm popularises the word across the country.
items.cn: 一八八八年的大风暴使这个词在全国流行。

items.en: Weather services define a blizzard by wind speed and visibility.
items.cn: 气象部门以风速与能见度界定暴风雪。

items.en: Blizzard also means any sudden flood of requests or paper.
items.cn: 现代也指任何突然涌来的大量请求或文件。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -zard ending or the short bl- shape; the near-meaning group gathers the words for violent weather.
note.cn: 形近组共享 -zard 词尾或短 bl- 形状；近义组汇集表示猛烈天气的词。

entries.definition: A sudden intensive military or media attack.
entries.definitionCN: 突然而猛烈的军事或舆论攻势。

entries.definition: The muscular stomach of a bird.
A person with supposed magic powers.
Weather in which snow hides all landmarks.
entries.definitionCN: 雪遮住一切地标的天气。

entries.definition: A sudden violent gust of wind.
A violent storm, often in literature.
entries.definitionCN: 常带文学色彩的大风暴。

normalIntro.en: A blizzard is snow driven sideways so hard that the road disappears; the name sounds like a blow.
normalIntro.cn: blizzard 是横着抽来的雪，把路都埋了；这个词听起来就像一记重击。

normal.en: The word is American and its origin is still unknown.
normal.cn: 这个词是美国英语，来源至今不明。

normal.en: An older dialect sense was a violent blow.
normal.cn: 较早的方言义是「猛烈一击」。

normal.en: Snow plus wind equals no visibility.
normal.cn: 雪加风，等于看不见路。

normal.en: Roads close, and the forecast warns before it comes.
normal.cn: 道路封闭，预报会提前警告。

normal.en: Paper can arrive like weather too.
normal.cn: 文书也能像天气一样扑过来。

abstract.en: A wall of white moving toward you.
abstract.cn: 朝你推来的一堵白墙。

abstract.en: A horizon removed in one night.
abstract.cn: 一夜之间被拿走的地平线。

abstract.en: Weather that behaves like a crowd.
abstract.cn: 像人群一样行动的天气。

examples.en: A blizzard shut the airport for two days.
examples.cn: 一场暴风雪使机场关闭两天。

examples.en: They were caught in a blizzard above the treeline.
examples.cn: 他们在林线以上遇上了暴风雪。

examples.en: The new rules produced a blizzard of objections.
examples.cn: 新规定引来了铺天盖地的反对。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不理事」——暴风雪一来，什么事都停了，人都被雪关在屋里。

root: 美国英语 blizzard（19 世纪初），词源未确定；较早方言义为「猛烈的一击」

sensesIntro.en: A storm that erases the road and a flood of paper that erases your desk are the same event seen twice.
sensesIntro.cn: 抹掉道路的风雪，与抹掉桌面的文书洪水，是同一件事被看两遍。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: snow driven flat across a buried highway
core.cn: 核心意象：横着抽来的雪，盖住了公路

branches.en: A headlight finding nothing in the snow.
branches.cn: 车灯在雪里什么也照不到。

branches.en: A closed pass with one plough inside.
branches.cn: 封住的山口里只停着一辆铲雪车。

branches.en: A tray of forms arriving at once.
branches.cn: 一次送上来的整盘表格。

branches.en: A phone that will not stop ringing.

intro.en: Blizzard is a bare noun of unknown origin, but the endings below spread across its weather family.
intro.cn: blizzard 是来源不明的单纯名词，但下面的词缀横跨它的天气词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin nix is snow, tempestas is storm, and ventus is wind.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 nix 意为雪，tempestas 意为风暴，ventus 意为风。

latinEntries.exampleCN: nix 是 niveous 的词根。
tempestas 产生 tempest。
ventus 产生 vent 与 ventilate。

definition_zh: 大块；街区；障碍物；阻挡
definition_en: a solid piece of material with flat sides
core_image: 堆在墙边的方形石料
scene: 墙边码着几块方形石料。A fallen tree blocked the narrow road.
sceneCN: 这里 block 是「阻挡」（第 4 个义项：使无法通过）；句意是一棵倒下的树挡住了窄路。

derivatives.zh: 堵塞，管道等被堵住的状态

senses.title: A solid piece of material
senses.definition: a solid piece with flat sides
senses.definitionCN: 有平面的坚实一块
senses.example: The wall was built from blocks of stone.
senses.exampleCN: 这堵墙是用一块块石头砌成的。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, a lump of wood or stone.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，指一块木头或石头。

senses.title: The area between streets
senses.definition: the group of buildings between two streets
senses.definitionCN: 两条街之间的一片建筑
senses.example: The school is two blocks away.
senses.exampleCN: 学校在两个街区之外。
senses.why: City blocks were shaped like the solid blocks of stone.
senses.whyCN: 城市街区就像一块块坚实的石料。

senses.title: Something in the way
senses.definition: something that stops movement through a passage
senses.definitionCN: 挡住通道、使无法通过的东西
senses.example: There was a block in the pipe.
senses.exampleCN: 管子里有一处堵塞。
senses.why: A solid lump in a passage stops what flows through it.
senses.whyCN: 通道里的一块实心物，会挡住流过去的东西。

senses.title: To stop movement through
senses.definition: to prevent something from passing
senses.definitionCN: 使某物无法通过
senses.example: A fallen tree blocked the narrow road.
senses.exampleCN: 一棵倒下的树挡住了窄路。
senses.why: The noun turned into the action of putting a block in the way.
senses.whyCN: 名词转成了「把障碍放到路上」这个动作。

intro.en: Block came from a Dutch word for a tree trunk or lump.
intro.cn: block 来自一个表示树干或大块的荷兰语词。

items.en: blok meant a tree trunk or a lump.
items.cn: blok 意为树干或大块。

items.en: bloc carried the sense of a solid mass.
items.cn: bloc 保留了「坚实的一团」这一意思。

items.en: block named a piece of wood or stone.
items.cn: block 指一块木头或石头。

items.en: block named a group of houses.
items.cn: block 开始指一片房屋。

items.en: to block became a common verb.
items.cn: 动词 block 成为常用说法。

items.en: block covers lumps, streets and stopping movement.
items.cn: 如今 block 兼指大块、街区与阻挡。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bl- and -ock shapes; the near-meaning group names bricks and barriers.
note.cn: 形近组共用 bl- 与 -ock 的形状；近义组是砖石与障碍类词。

entries.definition: a device that shows the time
a group of sheep or birds
a baked clay block for building

normalIntro.en: A block is a lump that can build a wall or stop a road.
normalIntro.cn: block 是一块既能砌墙、也能挡路的东西。

normal.en: A block of stone is the basic image.
normal.cn: a block of stone 是最基本的意象。

normal.en: Two blocks away is a common direction.
normal.cn: two blocks away 是常见的指路说法。

normal.en: Block the road uses the verb.
normal.cn: block the road 用的是动词义。

normal.en: A blockage stops a pipe.
normal.cn: blockage 指管道堵塞。

normal.en: Black is a colour; block is a lump.
normal.cn: black 是颜色，block 是实心块。

abstract.en: See square stones stacked by a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象墙边码着方形石块。

abstract.en: See a street corner with tall buildings.
abstract.cn: 想象街角立着高楼。

abstract.en: See a tree lying across a path.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵树横在小路上。

examples.en: The wall was built from blocks of stone.
examples.cn: 这堵墙是用一块块石头砌成的。

examples.en: The school is two blocks away.
examples.cn: 学校在两个街区之外。

examples.en: A fallen tree blocked the narrow road.
examples.cn: 一棵倒下的树挡住了窄路。

dict_mnemonic.text: block 与 black 只差一个元音，黑色的石头码成一块块，就是 block。

root: block 源自中古荷兰语 blok（树干、大块），经古法语 bloc 进入英语，先指木石大块，十七世纪起指成片的房屋，十九世纪又发展出阻挡的动词义。

sensesIntro.en: A stone lump, a city square, an obstacle, and the act of stopping.
sensesIntro.cn: 一块石料、一个城市街区、一处障碍，以及阻挡的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: square stone blocks stacked beside a wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：墙边码着的方形石块。

intro.en: Block adds -age for a blockage and -ed for a blocked thing.
intro.cn: block 加 -age 构成堵塞名词，加 -ed 构成被堵的状态。

latinIntro.en: The base is Dutch; Latin items below are related in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自荷兰语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

definition_zh: n. 封锁；封锁部队；障碍物；v. 封锁；堵塞
definition_en: the sealing off of a place to stop goods or people moving in or out
core_image: 铁链横锁港口，商船尽数折返
scene: 海军舰队一字排开，铁链锁住了港湾出口。The navy imposed a blockade on the enemy coast.
sceneCN: 这里 blockade 是名词「封锁」（第 1 个义项：以武力切断往来）；句意是海军对敌方海岸实施了封锁。

derivatives.zh: blockade 加 runner 的复合词，义为「突破封锁者」

senses.title: Sealing off a coast or port by force
senses.definition: the use of ships or troops to stop movement in or out of an area
senses.definitionCN: 以舰船或军队切断一地的进出
senses.example: The navy imposed a blockade on the enemy coast.
senses.exampleCN: 海军对敌方海岸实施了封锁。
senses.why: A block is anything that stops movement; -ade makes the stopping into an action.
senses.whyCN: block 指一切阻隔之物，后缀 -ade 把阻隔化为行动。

senses.title: The force carrying out the blockade
senses.definition: the ships or troops stationed to enforce a blockade
senses.definitionCN: 驻守以执行封锁的舰船或部队
senses.example: The blockade seized three ships trying to slip out.
senses.exampleCN: 封锁部队截获了三艘试图溜出的船。
senses.why: The action names the actors who carry it out.
senses.whyCN: 行动之名转指执行行动之人。

senses.title: A physical barrier blocking a road
senses.definition: a barrier placed to block a road, street, or passage
senses.definitionCN: 阻断道路或通道的障碍物
senses.example: Protesters built a blockade of burning tyres.
senses.exampleCN: 抗议者用燃烧的轮胎筑起路障。
senses.why: Block in its concrete sense of a heavy mass supplies the object.
senses.whyCN: block 的「大块实体」本义提供了障碍之物象。

senses.title: Stopping supplies in war or dispute
senses.definition: cutting off food, fuel, or trade to force surrender
senses.definitionCN: 切断粮食、燃料或贸易以迫降
senses.example: The blockade starved the city into surrender.
senses.exampleCN: 封锁令该城饥饿而降。
senses.why: Sealing the exits seals the stomach; the siege logic is ancient.
senses.whyCN: 封住出口即封住肠胃，围困之理自古如此。

senses.title: A commercial embargo
senses.definition: a legal or political bar on trade with a place
senses.definitionCN: 对某地贸易的法律或政治禁阻
senses.example: The blockade on exports ruined the plantation economy.
senses.exampleCN: 出口封锁令种植园经济崩溃。
senses.why: Trade is traffic like any other; stopping it is a block in another lane.
senses.whyCN: 贸易亦如车流，禁断贸易即另一条车道上的阻隔。

senses.title: To seal off with a blockade
senses.definition: to surround a place with forces so nothing passes
senses.definitionCN: 以兵力围困一地使其无法通行
senses.example: Rebel forces blockaded the capital for months.
senses.exampleCN: 叛军对首都实施了数月封锁。
senses.why: The noun made a verb, as actions so often become commands.
senses.whyCN: 名词转动词，行动之名变为行动之令。

senses.title: To obstruct passage or progress
senses.definition: to block movement, plans, or negotiation
senses.definitionCN: 阻隔通行、计划或谈判
senses.example: Medical aid was blockaded at the border.
senses.exampleCN: 医疗援助在边境受阻。
senses.why: Any stopping wall, of steel or of rules, is a block.
senses.whyCN: 无论是钢铁还是规章，凡阻隔之墙皆为 block。

senses.title: A physiological blockage
senses.definition: a medical stoppage, such as a nerve or vessel block
senses.definitionCN: 神经或血管等在医学上的阻断
senses.example: A nerve blockade relieved the surgical pain.
senses.exampleCN: 神经阻滞缓解了术后疼痛。
senses.why: The body has its own roads; stopping one is a block of the same kind.
senses.whyCN: 身体自有道路，阻断其一即为同义之 block。

intro.en: Blockade is block plus the French noun suffix -ade.
intro.cn: blockade 由 block 加法语名词后缀 -ade 构成。

items.en: bloc meant a log or mass, source of English block.
items.cn: 古法语 bloc 意为「圆木、大块」，是英语 block 的来源。

items.en: the French word may come from Dutch blok, a trunk or mass.
items.cn: 法语词或出自荷兰语 blok「树干、大块」。

items.en: bloquate or blockade appeared in 17th-century French naval language for sealing a coast.
items.cn: 17 世纪法国海军用语中出现 bloquate／blockade，指封锁海岸。

items.en: English took blockade in the 17th century during naval wars.
items.cn: 英语于 17 世纪海战期间借入 blockade。

items.en: now covers military, civil, and even medical blocking.
items.cn: 今涵盖军事、民事乃至医学的阻断之义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the block root; the near-meaning group gathers siege words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 block 词根；近义组收围困类词。

entries.definition: a thing that blocks a pipe or passage
a ship that evades a blockade

a line of guards sealing an area

normalIntro.en: Blockade is block plus -ade, the act of blocking a whole place.
normalIntro.cn: blockade 即 block 加 -ade，对整个地方实施阻隔。

normal.en: The verb form blockades in the third person, past blockaded.
normal.cn: 动词三单 blockades，过去式 blockaded。

normal.en: Lift, impose, and run all pair with blockade.
normal.cn: lift、impose、run 都可与 blockade 搭配。

normal.en: Barricade is a road block; blockade seals a whole area.
normal.cn: barricade 是路障，blockade 封锁整个区域。

normal.en: It is a standard word in war reporting.
normal.cn: 它是战争报道的常用词。

normal.en: Medicine borrowed it for nerve blocks.
normal.cn: 医学借它指神经阻滞。

abstract.en: See a chain of grey warships around a harbour mouth.
abstract.cn: 看环绕港湾的灰色军舰锁链。

abstract.en: Feel a market with shelves bare of imports.
abstract.cn: 感受货架上空空如也的市场。

abstract.en: Picture burning tyres steaming across a highway.
abstract.cn: 想象高速路上冒烟的燃烧轮胎。

examples.en: The navy imposed a blockade on the enemy coast.
examples.cn: 海军对敌方海岸实施了封锁。

examples.en: The blockade starved the city into surrender.
examples.cn: 封锁令该城饥饿而降。

examples.en: Medical aid was blockaded at the border.
examples.cn: 医疗援助在边境受阻。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不 Lapkeid」不好记？直接拆：block（堵）+ ade（行动）——把整个港口「堵」起来便是封锁。

root: block（经古法语 bloc，或出自荷兰语 blok「大块、圆木」）加法语名词后缀 -ade（表行动）；17 世纪经法国海军用语进入英语，义为「以武力封闭一地」，后扩指一切阻断行为。

sensesIntro.en: From chained harbours to barred borders to blocked nerves, blockade is the sealing of any road of life.
sensesIntro.cn: 从锁链封锁的港湾到受阻的边境再到被阻滞的神经，blockade 指对一切生命通道的封闭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chain of warships sealing a harbour mouth
core.cn: 核心意象：锁住港湾口的军舰锁链

branches.en: Military sealing of coasts and cities
branches.cn: 对海岸与城市的军事封锁

intro.en: The -ade suffix turns a block into a campaign.
intro.cn: -ade 后缀把「阻隔」化为一场行动。

latinIntro.en: Germanic block via French suffix.
latinIntro.cn: 日耳曼词根 block 经法语后缀组合。

definition_zh: 轰动之作；票房大片；重磅炸弹；巨星级事件
definition_en: something overwhelmingly successful, especially a big-budget film
core_image: 影院门口排到街角的长队和巨幅海报
scene: 影院门口的巨幅海报下，队伍一直排到街角。The summer blockbuster broke every box office record.
sceneCN: 这里 blockbuster 是「票房大片」（第 1 个义项：极其卖座的巨制）；句意是这部暑期大片打破了所有票房纪录。

pos.zh: 轰动之作；大片；重磅事物

derivatives.zh: 复合形容词，义为「大片式的；轰动级的」
美语房地产用语，义为「鼓动恐慌性抛售（歧视性做法）」

senses.title: A hugely successful film
senses.definition: an expensive, widely marketed film that earns enormous returns
senses.definitionCN: 投入大、宣传广且收益巨大的影片
senses.example: The summer blockbuster broke every box office record.
senses.exampleCN: 这部暑期大片打破了所有票房纪录。
senses.why: A bomb in the old sense was a hit; the film sense kept the blast imagery.
senses.whyCN: 旧语中 bomb 可指大获成功，影义保留了「爆炸」的意象。

senses.title: A very powerful explosive bomb
senses.definition: a bomb large enough to destroy a whole block of buildings
senses.definitionCN: 威力足以摧毁整个街区的炸弹
senses.example: Wartime blockbusters flattened entire streets.
senses.exampleCN: 战时的重磅炸弹将整条街道夷平。
senses.why: The word literally names a bomb that busts a city block.
senses.whyCN: 该词本义即「炸毁街区（block）的弹（buster）」。

senses.title: Any smashing success
senses.definition: a book, show, or product with enormous popularity
senses.definitionCN: 大受欢迎的书、演出或产品
senses.example: Her debut novel became an instant blockbuster.
senses.exampleCN: 她的处女作小说一经问世便轰动一时。
senses.why: Success that demolishes rivals shares the demolition image.
senses.whyCN: 击垮对手的成功共享「炸毁」的意象。

senses.title: A major deal or agreement
senses.definition: an unusually large or important business deal
senses.definitionCN: 规模或分量异乎寻常的商业交易
senses.example: The two firms announced a blockbuster merger.
senses.exampleCN: 两家公司宣布了一桩重磅合并。
senses.why: A deal that reshapes a whole market busts the block of business as usual.
senses.whyCN: 重塑整个市场的交易，炸开的是「惯例的街区」。

senses.title: A best-selling prescription drug
senses.definition: a medicine whose sales exceed a billion units or dollars a year
senses.definitionCN: 年销售逾十亿（美元或剂量）的药物
senses.example: The company's blockbuster treated millions of patients.
senses.exampleCN: 该公司的重磅药物惠及数百万患者。
senses.why: Pharma borrowed the hit image for drugs that demolish sales charts.
senses.whyCN: 制药业借「爆款」意象，形容横扫销售榜的药物。

senses.title: A sensational news story
senses.definition: a news report of stunning importance
senses.definitionCN: 重要性令人震惊的新闻报道
senses.example: The paper ran a blockbuster on the corruption ring.
senses.exampleCN: 该报刊出震动一时的腐败集团报道。
senses.why: News that flattens reputations borrows the bomb image.
senses.whyCN: 足以轰塌名声的新闻，自然借用炸弹之象。

senses.title: A decisive sports victory or event
senses.definition: a match or event of exceptional excitement and scale
senses.definitionCN: 规模与热度 exceptional 的比赛或活动
senses.example: Tonight's final is being billed as a blockbuster.
senses.exampleCN: 今晚的决赛被宣传为一场巅峰对决。
senses.why: Events too big for the ordinary stage get the biggest word.
senses.whyCN: 超出寻常舞台规模的盛事，自然配得上最大的词。

senses.title: A hard-hitting legal or political blow
senses.definition: a sweeping ruling, law, or strike that changes the landscape
senses.definitionCN: 改变格局的重大裁决、法案或罢工
senses.example: The court's blockbuster reshaped election law.
senses.exampleCN: 法院的这一重磅裁决重塑了选举法。
senses.why: A ruling that levels old rules is a bomb on the legal block.
senses.whyCN: 铲平旧规的裁决，就是投在法律街区的一枚炸弹。

intro.en: Blockbuster began as wartime slang for a bomb big enough to destroy a block.
intro.cn: blockbuster 始于战时俚语，指足以摧毁一个街区的巨型炸弹。

items.en: RAF crews and press coined blockbuster for the largest bombs of the Blitz era.
items.cn: 1942 年前后，英国空军与新闻界造出 blockbuster，指闪电战时代最大的炸弹。

items.en: American speech immediately widened it to any smashing success, even a hit song.
items.cn: 美国英语随即把词义扩大为任何轰动性成功，甚至用于畅销歌曲。

items.en: Jaws and later Star Wars fixed the film sense of the big summer hit.
items.cn: 20 世纪 70 年代《大白鲨》及后来的《星球大战》固定了「暑期巨片」之义。

items.en: pharma and finance adopted the word for billion-scale successes.
items.cn: 制药与金融界借该词形容十亿量级的成功。

items.en: the original bomb sense survives mainly in historical writing.
items.cn: 原初的炸弹义今主要见于历史写作。

note.en: The word is a fresh compound; look-alikes share block or bust, near-meanings share the hit idea.
note.cn: 该词是新兴复合词；形近组含 block 或 bust，近义组含「爆款」之义。

normal.en: It is one word, not block buster.

normal.en: Blockbuster drug is standard pharma talk.

normal.en: The video rental chain took its name from this word.

examples.cn: 两家公司宣布了一桩重磅合并。

examples.en: The paper ran a blockbuster on the corruption ring.

sensesIntro.en: From a bomb that flattened streets to films that flatten rivals, blockbuster has always meant enormous force.

sensesIntro.en: A hair colour, and then the woman who has it.

definition_zh: 开花；绽放；花朵
definition_en: to produce flowers
core_image: 枝头刚刚绽开的玫瑰
scene: 一夜之间，院里的玫瑰枝头全开了。The roses bloom in early summer.

pos.zh: 动词：开花；绽放；焕发光彩

derivatives.zh: 语义关联词，义为「花朵」，与 bloom 同指树上开的花

senses.title: To produce flowers
senses.definition: to open into flowers
senses.definitionCN: 绽开成为花朵
senses.example: The roses bloom in early summer.
senses.exampleCN: 玫瑰在初夏开花。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, the opening of a flower.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，指花朵开放。

senses.title: A flower or the flowering state
senses.definition: a flower, or the period when plants flower
senses.definitionCN: 一朵花，或植物开花的时期
senses.example: The garden is in full bloom.
senses.exampleCN: 花园里花开正盛。

senses.title: To grow healthy and confident

normal.cn: in full bloom 表示花开到最盛。

normal.en: Bloom works as both verb and noun.
normal.cn: bloom 既可作动词也可作名词。

normal.en: Blossom is close in meaning.
normal.cn: blossom 与它意思接近。

normal.en: The plural adds s.
normal.cn: 复数加 s。

normal.en: The double o looks like two buds.
normal.cn: 其中的双 o 像两个并排的花苞。

abstract.en: See roses opening overnight.
abstract.cn: 想象玫瑰一夜之间开放。

abstract.en: See bees moving between petals.
abstract.cn: 想象蜜蜂在花瓣间穿行。

abstract.en: See a shy person suddenly laughing.
abstract.cn: 想象一个腼腆的人忽然笑开。

examples.en: The roses bloom in early summer.
examples.cn: 玫瑰在初夏开花。

examples.en: The garden is in full bloom.
examples.cn: 花园里花开正盛。

examples.en: She bloomed after moving to the coast.
examples.cn: 搬到海边之后，她整个人焕发光彩。

dict_mnemonic.text: bloom 里的双 o 像两朵并排的小花，看到双 o 就想到开花。

root: bloom 源自古诺斯语 blom（花），中古英语进入英语后先指花朵，再指开花的动作，十六世纪起又引申为人生的盛年与脸上的光泽。

sensesIntro.en: A flower opens, a garden flowers, and a person flourishes.
sensesIntro.cn: 一朵花开、一园花放、一个人焕发光彩。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rose opening on a branch overnight.
core.cn: 核心意象：一夜之间枝头绽开的玫瑰。

intro.en: Bloom takes -ing for an adjective and shares a family with blossom.
intro.cn: bloom 加 -ing 构成形容词，并与 blossom 同族。

latinIntro.en: The base is Norse; Latin items below are related in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自诺斯语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

items.meaning: the coloured part of a plant

definition_zh: n. 花（尤指果树花）；v. 开花；成长，繁荣
definition_en: a flower, especially on a fruit tree; to open into flower; to develop and flourish
core_image: 四月的果园一片雪白，每根枝条都压着花
scene: 四月的果园一片白，每棵苹果树都开满了花。In April the orchard was white, every apple tree in blossom.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：blossom 指果树开的花；句意是四月果园一片白，苹果树都在开花。

senses.title: The flower of a fruit tree
senses.definition: a flower or mass of flowers, especially on a tree that will bear fruit
senses.definitionCN: 果树上的花或成片的花
senses.example: The plum blossom comes before the leaves each year.
senses.exampleCN: 每年梅花都先于叶子开放。
senses.why: Old English blōstm is related to blow, in its old sense of bursting into flower.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 blōstm 与 blow 相关，取其「绽放」的古义。

senses.title: To come into flower
senses.definition: to produce flowers as part of a yearly cycle
senses.definitionCN: 在年度周期中开花
senses.example: The hedges blossom in late May.
senses.exampleCN: 灌木篱在五月下旬开花。
senses.why: The noun became a verb without changing shape, as many English plant words do.
senses.whyCN: 名词原形转为动词，许多英语植物词都如此。

senses.title: To grow and develop well
senses.definition: to develop successfully, often after a good start
senses.definitionCN: 在良好开端之后顺利发展
senses.example: The small label blossomed into a global brand.
senses.exampleCN: 这个小品牌发展成了全球品牌。
senses.why: A tree at full flower is the image of anything reaching its best stage.
senses.whyCN: 满树繁花正是任何事物到达最佳阶段的意象。

intro.en: Blossom is Old English blōstm, related to bloom and to the old verb blow, to burst into flower.
intro.cn: blossom 是古英语 blōstm，与 bloom 及古动词 blow（绽放）相关。

items.en: A Germanic root means to bloom or flourish.
items.cn: 一个日耳曼词根意为开花、繁盛。

items.en: Blōstm names a flower, especially of a fruit tree.
items.cn: blōstm 指花，尤指果树的花。

items.en: Bloom and blossom grow from the same family of words.
items.cn: bloom 与 blossom 出自同一词族。

items.en: The word is fixed to apple and cherry trees in farming texts.
items.cn: 农书中这个词固定用于苹果与樱桃树。

items.en: Writers extend blossom to people and projects.
items.cn: 作家把 blossom 用于人与事业。

items.en: In blossom remains the standard phrase for a flowering tree.
items.cn: in blossom 仍是「树在开花」的标准说法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bl- or -om shape; the near-meaning group moves from the flower itself to the act of thriving.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bl- 或 -om 形状；近义组由花本身移到繁盛的动作。

entries.definition: A flower, or the state of flowering.
The chest, or a close friendship.
A light shirt worn by women.
The coloured part of a plant.
A small unopened growth on a plant.
To grow well and stay healthy.

normalIntro.en: Blossom is the tree version of a flower, and it doubles as the verb for anything coming into its best season.
normalIntro.cn: blossom 是树上的花，也兼指任何事物进入最好时节。

normal.en: Blossom, bloom and blow all share an old bloom root.
normal.cn: blossom、bloom、blow 共享古老的「开花」词根。

normal.en: Apple blossom comes before the apple.
normal.cn: 苹果花先于苹果而来。

normal.en: In blossom is the phrase for a tree at its white peak.
normal.cn: in blossom 就是树开到最白的时候。

normal.en: A business can blossom like a tree.
normal.cn: 一门生意也能像树一样繁花盛开。

normal.en: If the whole branch is white, it is blossom, not just a flower.
normal.cn: 整条枝都白了，那叫 blossom，而不只是一朵花。

abstract.en: A tree spending everything it has on white.
abstract.cn: 把全部力气开成白色的树。

abstract.en: A promise that fruit will follow.
abstract.cn: 预示果实将至的承诺。

abstract.en: Becoming visible all at once.
abstract.cn: 一下子显形。

examples.en: The cherry trees are in blossom for two weeks only.
examples.cn: 樱花只开两周。

examples.en: Their friendship blossomed after the trip.
examples.cn: 旅行之后，他们的友谊发展起来。

examples.en: The garden blossoms from March to June.
examples.cn: 花园从三月开到六月。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不落色」——花开得正盛，一树颜色怎么也不肯落下，要等花期尽了才谢。

root: 古英语 blōstm（花）← 日耳曼词根「开花、繁盛」；与 bloom 同族

sensesIntro.en: Flower, flowering, flourishing: the noun becomes a verb, and the verb becomes a metaphor for success.
sensesIntro.cn: 花、开花、繁盛：名词转成动词，动词又成为成功的比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an orchard turned white, every branch loaded with flower
core.cn: 核心意象：果园一片雪白，每根枝条都压满花

branches.en: A hedge opening all at once.
A small shop becoming a chain.
A stage that looks like success.

intro.en: Blossom takes ordinary noun and verb endings; the list below builds its forms and the vocabulary of plants and growth.
intro.cn: blossom 配普通名词与动词词尾；下面列出它的各种形式，以及植物生长词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin flos is a flower, florere is to bloom, and crescere is to grow.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 flos 意为花，florere 意为开花，crescere 意为生长。

latinEntries.exampleCN: flos 产生 floral 与 flourish。
florere 产生 flourish 与 florid。
crescere 产生 crescent 与 increase。

definition_zh: n. 吸墨纸（垫）；（美国）警方记事簿，值勤记录
definition_en: a pad of absorbent paper for drying ink; in the United States, a police record of daily arrests and incidents
core_image: 桌上一块皮面垫子，纸角被墨水洇出一小片深色
scene: 柜台上摆着一本皮面记事簿，当天每一次报警都记在上面。A leather blotter on the counter recorded every call that day.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：blotter 在美式用法中指警方的每日记事簿；句意是柜台上那本记事簿记着当天所有报警。

collocations.phrase: the blotter at the front desk

senses.title: A pad that dries ink
senses.definition: a pad of thick absorbent paper on which wet ink is dried
senses.definitionCN: 用以吸干未干墨迹的厚吸水纸垫
senses.example: He pressed the letter on the blotter before folding it.
senses.exampleCN: 他把信按在吸墨垫上吸干，然后折起来。
senses.why: Blot is a spot of ink, and -er makes the thing that deals with it.
senses.whyCN: blot 是一点墨渍，-er 表示处理它的东西。

senses.title: The police daily record
senses.definition: in American usage, the book in which a police station records each day arrests and calls
senses.definitionCN: 美式用法中，警局记录每日逮捕与报警的本子
senses.example: His name was on the blotter by nine in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 上午九点他的名字就上了记事簿。
senses.why: A book that absorbs each day like a blotter absorbs ink gave the record its nickname.
senses.whyCN: 一本像吸墨纸那样把每天吸进去的本子，就这样得了这个绰号。

intro.en: Blotter is blot plus -er; blot first meant a spot or stain in the fourteenth century.
intro.cn: blotter 是 blot 加 -er；blot 在十四世纪最初指污点、墨渍。

items.en: English blot names a spot or a smear of ink.
items.cn: 英语 blot 指墨点或墨污。

items.en: Blotch splits off to name a larger irregular mark.
items.cn: blotch 分出，指较大而不规则的斑。

items.en: Absorbent paper is used to dry handwriting.
items.cn: 吸水纸被用来吸干手写墨迹。

items.en: The pad and the desk book both take the name.
items.cn: 吸墨垫与桌上本子都得了这个名字。

items.en: American stations keep a daily blotter of arrests.
items.cn: 美国警局保留每日逮捕记事簿。

items.en: Digital logs still carry the old nickname.
items.cn: 电子日志仍沿用这个旧绰号。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the blot- stem or the -otter sound; the near-meaning group covers the pad and the record book.
note.cn: 形近组共享 blot- 词干或 -otter 音；近义组涵盖吸墨垫与记录本。

entries.definition: A spot of ink, or to dry it.
A large irregular mark or patch.
A mess of things lying about.
A thick piece of soft material.
A book of blank pages for notes.

normalIntro.en: Blot is an ink spot, so a blotter is what takes the ink; a police blotter takes the day instead.
normalIntro.cn: blot 是墨点，blotter 就是吸走墨的东西；警方的 blotter 吸走的是这一整天。

normal.en: Blot means a stain, and -er means the thing for it.
normal.cn: blot 是污渍，-er 表示处理它的东西。

normal.en: Press wet writing on the pad and the ink is gone.
normal.cn: 把湿字按在垫上，墨就不见了。

normal.en: A blotter is therefore an ink sponge.
normal.cn: 所以 blotter 就是一块吸墨海绵。

normal.en: Police stations keep a book that soaks up the day.
normal.cn: 警局有一本把每天都吸进去的本子。

normal.en: Paper or screen, the nickname survives.
normal.cn: 无论纸本还是屏幕，这个绰号都还在用。

abstract.en: A sheet that drinks mistakes.
abstract.cn: 一张把错处喝掉的纸。

abstract.en: A day pressed flat and kept.
abstract.cn: 被压平保存下来的一天。

abstract.en: The page behind every ink stain.
abstract.cn: 每一处墨渍背后的那一页。

examples.en: The blotter under his hand was dark with old ink.
examples.cn: 他手下的吸墨垫被旧墨染得发暗。

examples.en: Reporters read the police blotter every morning.
examples.cn: 记者每天早上都翻阅警方记事簿。

examples.en: Keep a blotter beside the inkwell.
examples.cn: 在墨水瓶旁放一块吸墨垫。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不漏它」——墨水滴下来，吸墨垫一滴也不漏地全吸住。

root: blot（墨渍、污点）+ -er（做……的物）

sensesIntro.en: One object absorbs ink and another absorbs a day; the second borrowed the first name.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个物件吸墨，另一个物件吸走一天，后者借用了前者的名字。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a leather pad with one fresh ink shadow on it
core.cn: 核心意象：一块皮面垫子上有一小片新墨影

branches.en: A letter pressed flat to dry.
A pad dark with years of ink.
branches.cn: 被多年墨迹染暗的垫子。

branches.en: A name written in a station book.
branches.cn: 写进警局本子里的一个名字。

branches.en: A night shift copied into a ledger.
Something that takes what falls on it.
branches.cn: 承接落下之物的一件东西。

intro.en: Blotter is a common English noun built from a verb stem; the list below adds the endings of its family and of record-keeping.
intro.cn: blotter 是由动词词干构成的普通英语名词；下面列出其词族的词尾与记录用语的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin linteum is a linen cloth, liber is a book, and commentarium is a notebook.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 linteum 意为亚麻布，liber 意为书，commentarium 意为笔记簿。

latinEntries.exampleCN: linteum 是 linen 的来源。
liber 产生 library 与 libel。
commentarium 产生 commentary。

definition_zh: n. 风倒（林木被风连根吹倒）；风倒区；（锅炉）排污
definition_en: trees blown down by wind, or the area where they lie; the release of water from a boiler to remove sediment
core_image: 风暴过后一坡的树干横七竖八，根盘朝上翻着
scene: 风暴过后，整片山坡横着倒下的树，树干相互交叠。After the storm a whole hillside lay flat in blowdown, trunks crossing one another.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：blowdown 指被风连根吹倒的林木及其区域；句意是风暴过后整片山坡都是横倒的树干。

pos.zh: 风倒；风倒林木；锅炉排污

senses.title: Trees felled by wind
senses.definition: trees uprooted or broken by strong wind, together with the ground where they lie
senses.definitionCN: 被强风连根拔起或折断的树木，以及它们倒卧的地面
senses.example: The road crew cleared a blowdown that had closed the track.
senses.exampleCN: 道路队清理了封住小道的风倒木。
senses.why: A compound of blow and down describes exactly what the wind did to the trees.
senses.whyCN: blow 与 down 的复合词，正好描述风对树做的事。

senses.title: Water released from a boiler
senses.definition: the controlled draining of water from a boiler to remove dissolved solids
senses.definitionCN: 为除去溶解固体而受控排放锅炉水的操作
senses.example: Regular blowdown keeps the boiler from scaling.
senses.exampleCN: 定期排污可防止锅炉结垢。
senses.why: The same compound names a downward blast of water in engineering, where blow means a forced flow.
senses.whyCN: 同一复合词在工程中指向下排放的水流，那里的 blow 意为强制流动。

intro.en: Blowdown is a plain English compound of blow and down, used in forestry and in boiler engineering.
intro.cn: blowdown 是 blow 与 down 组成的普通英语复合词，用于林业与锅炉工程。

items.en: Two native English words form the compound directly.
items.cn: 两个本土英语词直接复合。

items.en: North American foresters name wind-felled timber blowdown.
items.cn: 北美林务人员称风倒木为 blowdown。

items.en: Boiler texts use blowdown for water drained to clear solids.
items.cn: 锅炉文献用 blowdown 指排出的除垢水。

items.en: Loggers salvage blowdown after major storms.
items.cn: 伐木者在大型风暴后抢救风倒木。

items.en: Blowdown gaps become a unit of forest study.
items.cn: 风倒空隙成为森林研究的单位。

items.en: The word stays technical in both fields.
items.cn: 该词在两领域都保持技术性。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the compound shape with blow or down; the near-meaning group gathers the forestry words for fallen trees.
note.cn: 形近组共享含 blow 或 down 的复合形状；近义组汇集林业中「倒木」的词汇。

entries.definition: A sudden escape of air or oil.
entries.definitionCN: 气体或石油的突然喷出。

entries.definition: A failure of a machine or system.
A fly that lays eggs in meat.
In the direction the wind blows.
Fruit or timber blown down by wind.
entries.definitionCN: 被风吹落的果实或树木。

entries.definition: Trees uprooted by wind, as a forestry term.
entries.definitionCN: 林业术语，被风连根拔起的树。

entries.definition: To pull a plant out of the ground.

normalIntro.en: Blow plus down: the wind blows, and the whole stand goes down.
normalIntro.cn: blow 加 down：风一吹，整片林子就倒下去。

normal.en: Blow is what the wind does; down is where the trees go.
normal.cn: blow 是风做的，down 是树去的地方。

normal.en: A blowdown is a forest lying flat.
normal.cn: blowdown 就是躺平的森林。

normal.en: Root plates stand up like plates on edge.
normal.cn: 根盘立着，像竖起来的盘子。

normal.en: Loggers arrive afterwards to salvage the timber.
normal.cn: 伐木者之后赶来抢救木材。

normal.en: In a boiler the same word means water blown down and out.
normal.cn: 在锅炉里，同一个词指被向下排出的水。

abstract.en: A forest suddenly horizontal.
abstract.cn: 突然变成水平的森林。

abstract.en: Wind writing its signature in trunks.
abstract.cn: 风用树干签下的名字。

abstract.en: What a storm leaves to be cleaned.
abstract.cn: 风暴留下的待清之物。

examples.en: The study measured regrowth in a ten-year-old blowdown.
examples.cn: 这项研究测量了一片十年风倒区的再生情况。

examples.en: Salvage crews worked the blowdown all winter.
examples.cn: 抢救队整个冬天都在处理风倒木。

examples.en: Open the valve for a short blowdown each shift.
examples.cn: 每班短时排污一次。

dict_mnemonic.text: blow 是「吹倒」，down 是「倒下」——风一吹，树全倒在地上，就是风倒林。

root: blow（吹）+ down（向下）；英语复合词，林业与锅炉工程各有专义

sensesIntro.en: Wind lays a forest down; a boiler lays water down and out. Both are the same downward motion under pressure.
sensesIntro.cn: 风把林子放倒；锅炉把水向下排出。两者都是压力下的同一「向下」动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a slope of trunks lying across one another with roots turned up
core.cn: 核心意象：一坡树干横七竖八，根盘朝上

branches.en: Root plates drying in the sun.
A valve opened to drain the boiler.
Pressure forcing something down and out.
branches.cn: 把东西向下排出的压力。

intro.en: Blowdown is a native compound, so the list below covers its two parts and the endings that build similar compounds.
intro.cn: blowdown 是本土复合词，因此下面列出它的两个部件，以及构成同类复合词的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin cadere is to fall, ruere to rush down, and silva is a forest.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cadere 意为落下，ruere 意为冲下，silva 意为森林。

latinEntries.exampleCN: cadere 产生 cadence 与 accident。
ruere 产生 ruin 与 erosion。
silva 产生 sylvan 与 silviculture。

definition_zh: 蓝色的；忧郁的；蓝色
definition_en: having the colour of a clear sky
core_image: 正午无云的天空
scene: 正午的天空干净得没有一丝云。The lake turned deep blue at dusk.
sceneCN: 这里 blue 是「蓝色的」（第 1 个义项：像晴空那样的颜色）；句意是黄昏时湖水变成深蓝色。

senses.title: Of the colour of a clear sky
senses.definition: having the colour of a clear sky or the sea
senses.definitionCN: 像晴空或海水那样的颜色
senses.example: The lake turned deep blue at dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 黄昏时湖水变成深蓝色。
senses.why: This is the central sense, naming a basic colour.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心义项，指一种基本颜色。

senses.title: Sad and low in spirits
senses.definition: feeling sad or without hope
senses.definitionCN: 感到悲伤或没有希望
senses.example: He has been feeling blue since the move.
senses.exampleCN: 搬家之后他一直情绪低落。
senses.why: A cold grey-blue was linked to a low mood.
senses.whyCN: 阴冷的灰蓝色被与低落的情绪联系起来。

senses.title: The colour itself
senses.definition: the colour of the sky on a clear day
senses.definitionCN: 晴天时天空的那种颜色
senses.example: Blue suits her better than green.
senses.exampleCN: 蓝色比绿色更适合她。
senses.why: The adjective also stands alone as the name of the colour.
senses.whyCN: 形容词也可以单独作这种颜色的名称。

intro.en: Blue came through French from a Germanic colour word.
intro.cn: blue 经法语来自一个日耳曼语颜色词。

items.en: blao named a blue colour.
items.cn: blao 指一种蓝色。

items.en: bleu carried the word into French.
items.cn: bleu 把这个词带进法语。

items.en: blue replaced the older English colour word.
items.cn: blue 取代了英语原有的颜色词。

items.en: blue described a sad mood.
items.cn: blue 开始形容忧郁的情绪。

items.en: blue is both a colour and a feeling.
items.cn: 如今 blue 既是颜色，也是一种心情。

entries.definition: a sticky substance for joining things

normalIntro.en: Blue is the sky above and a low feeling inside.
normalIntro.cn: blue 既是头顶的天空，也是心里的低落。

normal.en: Blue is a basic colour word.
normal.cn: blue 是基本颜色词。

normal.en: Feel blue means feel sad.
normal.cn: feel blue 表示情绪低落。

normal.en: Out of the blue means unexpectedly.
normal.cn: out of the blue 表示出乎意料地。

normal.en: The comparative is bluer.
normal.cn: 比较级是 bluer。

normal.en: Blue sounds the same as blew.
normal.cn: blue 与 blew 读音相同。

abstract.en: See a cloudless noon sky.
abstract.cn: 想象正午没有一丝云的天空。

abstract.en: See deep water far from shore.
abstract.cn: 想象远离岸边的深水。

abstract.en: See someone sitting alone by a window.
abstract.cn: 想象有人独自坐在窗边。

examples.en: The lake turned deep blue at dusk.
examples.cn: 黄昏时湖水变成深蓝色。

examples.en: He has been feeling blue since the move.
examples.cn: 搬家之后他一直情绪低落。

examples.en: Blue suits her better than green.
examples.cn: 蓝色比绿色更适合她。

dict_mnemonic.text: blue 与 blew 同音，一个是颜色，一个是被吹的过去式，靠句子来分辨。

root: blue 经古法语 bleu 来自法兰克语 blao，中古英语时期取代了本土的颜色词；十六世纪起又与低落情绪相连，形成「忧郁」的引申义。

sensesIntro.en: A colour of sky and sea, and a colour of mood.
sensesIntro.cn: 既是天空与海水的颜色，也是心情的颜色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cloudless sky at noon.
core.cn: 核心意象：正午无云的天空。

intro.en: Blue takes -ish and -ness, and pairs with many colour words.
intro.cn: blue 可加 -ish 与 -ness，也能与许多颜色词组合。

latinIntro.en: The base is Germanic by way of French; Latin items below are related in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基属日耳曼语，经法语传入；下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

items.meaning: the salt water of the earth

definition_zh: n. 蓝图（工程图）；详细规划，行动方案；v. 详细规划
definition_en: a technical drawing reproduced in blue; a detailed plan for how something should be done; to plan in detail
core_image: 一大张蓝底白线的图纸摊在桌上，一个人的手指顺着管线移动
scene: 工程师把蓝图摊在桌上，手指顺着一段管线移动。The engineer spread the blueprint on the table and pointed at a run of pipe.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：blueprint 指蓝底白线的工程图；句意是工程师摊开蓝图，指着一段管线。

senses.title: A drawing printed in blue
senses.definition: a detailed technical drawing copied by a process that prints white lines on blue paper
senses.definitionCN: 以蓝底白线工艺复制的详细工程图
senses.example: The blueprint shows every pipe and every load-bearing wall.
senses.exampleCN: 这张蓝图标出了每根管线和每道承重墙。
senses.why: The cyanotype process turned drawings blue, and the print of that blue sheet gave the word its name.
senses.whyCN: 蓝晒法把图纸变成蓝色，印出的蓝纸便给了这个词名字。

senses.title: A detailed plan
senses.definition: a plan that sets out in detail how something should be built or done
senses.definitionCN: 详细说明某事应如何建成或完成的方案
senses.example: The report is a blueprint for cutting emissions.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告是削减排放的方案。
senses.why: A drawing that guides builders became the image of any plan that guides action.
senses.whyCN: 指导施工的图纸，成了任何指导行动之方案的意象。

senses.title: To plan in detail
senses.titleCN: 把方案细化到图纸级别
senses.definition: to work out a plan in full detail before acting
senses.definitionCN: 行动之前把方案完全细化
senses.example: The team blueprinted the whole rollout in a week.
senses.exampleCN: 团队用一周把整个推广方案细化完毕。
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb, as nouns for documents often do.
senses.whyCN: 表示文件的名词转为动词，这类转化很常见。

intro.en: Blueprint is blue plus print, named for the cyanotype copying process introduced in the 1840s.
intro.cn: blueprint 是 blue 加 print，得名于十九世纪四十年代引入的蓝晒复制法。

items.en: John Herschel develops a process that prints white lines on blue paper.
items.cn: John Herschel 发明一种在蓝纸上印白线的工艺。

items.en: Print at that time means a copy taken from an original.
items.cn: 当时的 print 意为从原件复制的副本。

items.en: Builders call the blue copies blueprints.
items.cn: 营造者把这种蓝色副本称作 blueprint。

items.en: The word becomes the general name for a working drawing.
items.cn: 该词成为施工图的通称。

items.en: Blueprints come to mean detailed plans of any kind.
items.cn: blueprint 引申为任何详细方案。

items.en: Drawings are now digital, but the word survives.
items.cn: 图纸早已数字化，这个词仍然沿用。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the blue- or -print build; the near-meaning group moves from the drawing to the plan and its drafting.
note.cn: 形近组共享 blue- 或 -print 构造；近义组由图纸移到方案与起草。

entries.definition: A plant with blue bell-shaped flowers.
A style of American country music.
The mark left by a fingertip.
A drawing or plan showing how something works.
entries.definitionCN: 说明某物如何运作的图样或方案。

entries.definition: An organised plan, sometimes with suspicion.
entries.definitionCN: 有条理的方案，有时含贬义。

entries.definition: A first rough version of a document.

normalIntro.en: A blueprint was literally a print in blue, and the colour stuck as the name of any detailed plan.
normalIntro.cn: blueprint 原本就是「蓝色的印本」，颜色留在了名字里，后来指任何详细方案。

normal.en: Blue plus print, nothing hidden in the word.
normal.cn: blue 加 print，词里没有别的机关。

normal.en: Early copies came out white on blue.
normal.cn: 早期复制品是蓝底白线。

normal.en: A blueprint tells builders exactly where to put things.
normal.cn: 蓝图告诉营造者每样东西该放在哪里。

normal.en: So a plan for reform can also be a blueprint.
normal.cn: 所以改革方案也能叫 blueprint。

normal.en: The drawing is digital now, but the name remains.
normal.cn: 图纸如今是数字的，名字却还在。

abstract.en: A picture that decides where walls go.
abstract.cn: 决定墙在哪里的图。

abstract.en: Intentions drawn to scale.
abstract.cn: 按比例画出的意图。

abstract.en: The future laid flat on a table.
abstract.cn: 摊在桌上的未来。

examples.en: The architect kept the 1920s blueprint in a flat drawer.
examples.cn: 建筑师把二十世纪二十年代的蓝图收在平抽屉里。

examples.en: The treaty became a blueprint for later agreements.
examples.cn: 这项条约成为后来各项协定的模板。

examples.en: They blueprinted the new service before hiring anyone.
examples.cn: 他们在招人之前就把新服务的细节规划好了。

dict_mnemonic.text: blue 是「蓝」，print 是「印」——蓝底白线的印本，后来就指任何详细规划。

root: blue（蓝）+ print（印本、复制件）；源自 1840 年代蓝晒复制工艺

sensesIntro.en: A drawing for builders, then the plan behind any building, then the act of planning: the noun spreads out and finally becomes a verb.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是给营造者的图，再是任何「建造」背后的方案，最后是规划这个动作：名词外扩，终于变成动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: white lines on blue paper with a fingertip tracing a pipe
core.cn: 核心意象：蓝底白线的图纸，指尖顺着管线移动

branches.en: A rolled drawing with a rubber band.
A wall marked with every load.
A policy document with steps and dates.
branches.cn: 写明步骤与日期的政策文件。

branches.en: Detail that removes doubt before building.
branches.cn: 施工前消除疑问的细节。

intro.en: Blueprint is a native compound with regular endings; the list below covers its parts and the vocabulary of drawing and planning.
intro.cn: blueprint 是配规则词尾的本土复合词；下面列出它的部件，以及制图与规划词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin plano means I flatten, designare means to mark out, and scribere means to write.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 plano 意为「我压平」，designare 意为标出，scribere 意为书写。

latinEntries.exampleCN: designare 产生 design 与 designate。
scribere 产生 scribe 与 script。

latinEntries.example: Plano lies behind plan and plain.
latinEntries.exampleCN: plano 是 plan 与 plain 的背景。
